recentItems.title: LIVE: View from Nepal after deadly floods
recentItems.description:
Watch live from an army camp in Nepal's Nuwakot district as the death toll from catastrophic flooding in Nepal and China rose over 1,000, authorities said, with rescue teams working to reach communities cut off by the disaster.
